thread:
elaine: One thread to finalize landing copy + routing for the tri-mode launch. Focus: crisp hero, webinar CTA placement, and where leads go.

ana: I'll propose micro-variants for each page: hero headline (max 7 words), short subhead (12 words max), and two CTAs (primary/secondary).

ana: Hosted H: "Ship features with a production-ready API"
ana: Hosted S: "Simple pricing, fast onboarding, predictable cost per token"

ana: Dedicated H: "Reserved capacity for critical workloads"
ana: Dedicated S: "Budgeted throughput, consistent latency, SLA options"

ana: Private H: "Private deployments that meet compliance needs"
ana: Private S: "VPC & on-prem options with enterprise controls"

mike: Keep subheads outcome-driven but shorter. Swap Hosted S to: "From prototype to production in hours".

rachel: For hero CTAs: Hosted primary "Start free trial" secondary "Watch launch webinar". Dedicated primary "Request capacity demo" secondary "Watch launch webinar". Private primary "Contact sales for private deployment" secondary "Watch launch webinar".

elaine: Routing rules recap: Hosted demo/form -> product self-serve queue. Dedicated & Private -> SDR enterprise queue. Webinar signups -> education nurture list. Always include a fallback "Talk to sales" that sets enterprise routing.

luis: Implementation note: add hidden inputs: lead_path (values: selfserve|enterprise|webinar), source_page (hosted|dedicated|private), utm_campaign=tri_mode_launch_2023. GTM events: tri_mode_cta_click (label=page), tri_mode_form_submit (label=lead_path). I'll push tags to /product-analytics.

jamal: Legal check: Private page must not promise certifications. Use "designed for compliance" not "certified" unless legal confirms. Flagging now.

mike: Webinar plan: 30 mins product + demo, 10 mins benchmarks & methodology, 20 mins customer stories + Q&A. Benchmarks slide must show methodology: model family, avg seq length, workload shape, test infra. Add explicit callout: "Your results will vary by model and workload."

elaine: Launch post tone: lead with customer problems (cost, latency, reliability), then introduce tri-mode approach, call out migration paths between modes. Keep hero lines from Ana. Mike to draft launch post by tomorrow 9am.

rachel: Copy tweak for migration: add a short line on each page: "Easily move from Hosted to Dedicated or Private as needs grow." Keep it subtle.

luis: For forms, include a hidden field lead_owner assigned at submit: product_owner for selfserve, sdr_team for enterprise. Also capture lead_timestamp for sequencing.

deploy-bot: Reminder: content freeze for landing pages at 2023-11-15T18:00:00Z.

elaine: Deliverables: Ana final copy by EOD, Luis tracking + hidden fields by 4pm PT, Rachel to update CTAs across pages, Mike launch post draft by 09:00 next day, Jamal to confirm legal language on Private by EOD.

mike: Thanks everyone. We'll treat this thread as canonical for copy + routing decisions. Ping here with any changes.
